updates.title: RBI Master Direction on Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) - Updated Guidelines
updates.summary: New guidelines on LRS annual limit and eligible investments

classification.one_line_summary: RBI updates LRS annual limit eligibility criteria for resident individuals
classification.why_it_matters: Direct impact on HNI offshore investment structuring. Changes to annual limit thresholds affect NRI and resident family trust remittances. Requires immediate client communication.

updates.title: IFSCA Circular on Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) - Registration in GIFT City
updates.summary: Guidelines for NBFC registration and compliance requirements in GIFT City

classification.one_line_summary: IFSCA simplifies NBFC licensing process and clarifies capital requirements for GIFT City operations
classification.why_it_matters: Affects wealth structuring through GIFT City entities. Lower compliance burden makes GIFT City funds more accessible for family office structures. Creates new opportunities for UHNW client vehicles.

updates.title: Supreme Court Judgment on Hindu Succession Act - Succession Rights of Adopted Daughters
updates.summary: Court clarifies succession rights parity between biological and adopted daughters under HSA

classification.one_line_summary: Supreme Court affirms equal succession rights for adopted daughters under Hindu Succession Act
classification.why_it_matters: Major precedent affecting family succession planning. Requires estate plan review for clients with adopted children. Impacts will documentation and testamentary provisions. Key trigger for proactive client outreach.

updates.title: CBDT Circular on Taxation of Trust Income - Clarification on Beneficiary Rights
updates.summary: Income Tax circular clarifies trust income attribution and beneficiary assessment

classification.one_line_summary: CBDT clarifies tax treatment of trust income and beneficiary attribution under Income Tax Act
classification.why_it_matters: Direct tax impact on family trust structures. Affects wealth management strategy for discretionary vs fixed trusts. Critical for NRI/foreign settlor trust taxation.

updates.title: RBI Press Release - SWIFT Standards for Cross-Border Wire Transfers
updates.summary: Mandatory implementation of enhanced SWIFT standards for international remittances

classification.one_line_summary: RBI mandates SWIFT standard compliance for cross-border fund transfers from India
classification.why_it_matters: Operational impact on cross-border remittance processing. Affects timing and documentation for offshore asset structuring. Minor compliance requirement but important for NRI clients.
